bugs.title: Fan relay chatters at threshold due to no hysteresis
bugs.description: The control logic at lines 72-79 sets the fan ON whenever tempC >= OPEN_C and OFF otherwise, with no hysteresis band and no debounce. Any noise around 28.0 C flips the output every 50 ms tick, producing the measured 46 toggles in a 5000 ms window (limit 2) and 64 toggles over the run. The spec's 24.0 C close threshold is never used, so the required deadband is absent. D9 toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.30 s (limit 2), and 64 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

bugs.title: No fault detection: sub-5 C and floating probe drive fan OFF
bugs.description: readTempC (lines 19-24) returns the raw scaled value with no validity check, and the control branch at lines 72-79 treats any reading below OPEN_C as a normal 'fan OFF' command. A 0 V disconnected probe or a 3 C cold reading therefore forces the fan OFF instead of the required safe ON, leaving D9 not HIGH for 5400 ms and 3010 ms respectively against the 600 ms allowance. There is no fault branch anywhere in loop() to force and hold the safe state. During the fault, D9 was not in safe state HIGH for 5400 ms (allowed 600 ms to react).
